title: Mookuthi Amman 2 Scores 3.6/10 With Critics
headline: Mookuthi Amman 2 Scores 3.6/10 With Critics
caption:
Mookuthi Amman 2 finishes last of the six Diwali releases idly ranked. All three reviews idly read in full fault the effects and the comedy and two fault the writing, though two say Nayanthara still holds the screen. NDTV's Latha Srinivasan says it "desperately needed a storytelling miracle".

idly's consolidated score: 3.6/10, the mean of 10 numeric ratings from idly's fixed panel of 47 Indian English-language outlets (newspapers, TV and news sites, established film publications), published on or after release and confirmed on the outlet's page or in two independent listings, converted to /10.

How much do the effects matter to you in a devotional fantasy, next to the story and the star?

Sources: ratings from OnlyKollywood, DT Next, Filmfare, NDTV, Times of India, India Today, Indian Express, Cinema Express, Gulte and Rediff; read on the outlets' pages or in thereviewmonk, Rotten Tomatoes, Sacnilk and BollyMovieReviewz. Highs and lows from the 3 reviews idly read in full: Gulte, DT Next and THR India.

Slide 3: what the 3 reviews idly read in full say. Highs: Nayanthara holds the screen (2 of 3). Lows: The VFX disappoint, some look AI-made (3 of 3); The comedy misfires (3 of 3); A weak screenplay (2 of 3). Slide 4: every counted rating out of 10: OnlyKollywood 6.0; DT Next 5.0; Filmfare 4.0; NDTV 4.0; Times of India 4.0; India Today 3.0; Indian Express 3.0; Cinema Express 3.0; Gulte 2.0; Rediff 2.0.

self.notes: keep 1: no confirmed runtime or certificate. Points rest on only 3 reviews read in full (the other pages could not be opened). OnlyKollywood 3/5, TOI 2/5 and Rediff 1/5 rest on the blind reviewer's page checks; 123Telugu dropped.
